title: JESUS SAID ALL THINGS ARE POSSIBLE - MARK 9-23

blocks.text: In this special writing let’s talk some about building your faith; healing and miracles for you; a gift from God! “All is yours by acceptance!” – “As Jesus said, All things are possible to the believer!”

“His compassion and divine love for you is greater than ever!” – No matter what Satan says, or confrontations of the flesh tells you, “Jesus is your constant protection in the time of troubles; and will forgive all thine iniquities and heal all thy diseases!” – As David confirmed what Jesus would be doing for us today. Don’t forget these are all of your benefits. Psalms 103:1-5, “Bless the Lord, O my soul; and all that is within me, bless his holy name. Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases; Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with loving kindness and tender mercies; Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.”

One time the Lord delivered and healed a whole nation and supplied all their needs! – Ps. 105:37, “He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.” – And He brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness! (vs. 43) – “So the closer we get to the translation more and more will He do for you my partners as we near that wonderful moment of His return!” By His stripes you are healed. (Isa. 53:5) – “Concerning the end of this last church age, we are in the last hour! The door is closing. – The midnight cry is definitely going forth among us! Let us shout the victory!”

And we see the Lord not only will heal and do many wonders for you, but will supply His peoples needs because time is short and the harvest will be a quick short work! – Here are some Scriptural promises for you! – Mark 9:23, All things are possible to him that believeth, and acts upon His Word! – Matt. 7:7, “Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.” – Jesus said, “Speak the Word only!” – In certain instances you can actually speak the word only and your request will be given! – One time Jesus miraculously fed 4,000 people. (Matt. 15:32-38) – Another time He fed 5,000 men beside women and children. (Matt. 14: 15-21) – So no matter what the condition or times it would be easy for Him to supply you or any of my partners’ families needs! – Prov. 3:10, “So shall thy barns be filled with plenty!” – Luke 6:38, “Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over!” Also remember Jesus fed the Israelites (all 2 million) each day in the wilderness with manna from Heaven. (Ex. 16:4-15) – “Great is our God!” He said, I will restore! (Joel 2:25) – He will not forget the restoration He promised His people in our Church Age!

“Soon this planet will be going through some cataclysmic changes not seen in thousands of years!” It seems like during the days of this scripture Gen. 10:25, wherein it says that during the days of Peleg; was the earth divided. – Evidently floods, quakes and etc. We are in store for some catastrophic altering soon! “Harvest time is soon ending and Jesus will sweep His Children upward!” – “The wise will understand, Jesus said!” No doubt the beginning of these scriptures are not far off. (Rev. 6:12-14 – Isa. 24:1)
They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; They shall mount up with wings as Eagles; They shall run, and not be weary; And they shall walk and not faint. Isa. 40:31
